Welcome to Ice Cream Truck, a cooking browser game by GamePix that will melt your heart and challenge your brain. This delightful game is all about serving ice cream to kids, but to do so, you need to master the art of mixing and matching two ice creams of the same type to create a better version. The more complex the ice cream, the more coins you earn, and the more you can upgrade your ice cream truck. Ice Cream Truck is a puzzle game like no other, with simple yet addictive gameplay that will keep you hooked for hours.

In Ice Cream Truck, the objective is straightforward: serve the right ice cream to the right kid. But, it's not as easy as it sounds. With a variety of ice cream flavors and colors to keep track of, you'll need to think strategically to fulfill each child's order. The game gets progressively harder as more levels are unlocked, introducing new ice cream flavors and increasing the number of kids to serve. But don't worry, the rewards are well worth the challenge.

Ice Cream Truck stands out from other puzzle games due to its unique twist on the classic matching mechanics. The game's colorful and vibrant graphics make it a joy to play, and the soothing background music will keep you relaxed and focused. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, Ice Cream Truck is a game that's perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.
